Heading title

Claude Tools lets developers connect models to external systems with a single, typed interface that handles retries, authentication and streaming results back to the model.

Teams that adopted the interface during the preview describe fewer brittle integrations, clearer error messages when a tool call fails, and simpler code paths for authentication and pagination.

Why it matters

Early users report that agents built on Claude Tools finish multi-step tasks more reliably and need fewer hand-written prompts to recover from errors in long-running workflows.
